name: check-workflow
description: Remove workflow rules that duplicate the ForgeSteward skills from a repository's agent instructions, contributor docs, and templates, then submit a PR or MR without merging.

interface.shortDescription: Remove project rules that duplicate the skills via a PR or MR.
interface.longDescription: Find workflow policy rules (issue readiness, task granularity, change-request scope, review classification and rounds, repair, merge follow-up, and handoff) in AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, workflow docs, and issue or change-request templates that duplicate the ForgeSteward skills, remove them together with workflow blocks written by earlier check-workflow versions, validate, and submit a PR or MR without merging. Project conventions such as language, formats, build commands, and engineering constraints are kept; nothing is added to the project; explicit check-only requests remain read-only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-check-workflow to remove workflow policy rules in this repository that duplicate the ForgeSteward skills, including workflow blocks written by earlier check-workflow versions, validate, then commit, push, and open a PR or MR without merging.
